position_overview: Job Title: Accounts Receivable Associate Location: Colombia (Remote) Type of Contract: Full-Time | EOR Salary Range: $1,000 - $1,400 USD per month Language Requirements: Advanced English (written and verbal) We are seeking a skilled Accounts Receivable Associate with hands-on experience in invoicing, payment processing, and financial reporting to join our growing accounting team. You will play a key role in managing receivables, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting collections efforts. Your work will directly impact cash flow accuracy, reporting reliability, and overall financial operations efficiency. Key Responsibilities: Process daily Accounts Receivable (A/R) transactions and generate reports in NetSuite Prepare, issue, and verify customer invoices for goods and services Record and track client payments including checks, EFT, ACH, and credit card transactions Investigate and resolve account discrepancies while supporting collections activities Maintain accurate and confidential financial records in compliance with company policies Organize and manage electronic financial documentation according to established procedures Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports for the Accounting Director Must-Have Qualifications: High school diploma or GED required (additional accounting coursework preferred) Minimum 1+ year of Accounts Receivable experience Working knowledge of accounting principles and financial practices Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting/ERP systems Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) Strong data entry skills, including 10-key by touch and minimum typing speed of 40 WPM Excellent written and verbal English communication skills High attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Preferred Qualifications: Associates degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field Experience working with U.S.-based companies Familiarity with internal controls and compliance standards Originally posted on Himalayas
